Thanks Marcus — quick internal cost model attached (summary below).

Summary:
- Datadog (current): best in-house telemetry (APM + logs) but retention is the cost driver — projected increase of 22% YoY at current ingestion rates.
- Sentry: low fixed price for events, good for lightweight error monitoring.
- Grafana Cloud: cheaper long-tail log storage + Loki cold storage, cheaper egress/export. Potential to offload 40% of daily GB to Grafana cold tier and save ~18% overall.

Recommendation:
1) Negotiate with Datadog for the 15% cross-product discount and take the 90-day retention pilot.
2) Pilot Grafana Cloud for cold retention for 3 months for buckets older than 7 days.
3) Keep Sentry for high-fidelity error events only.

Drive doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c_observability-eval

Grace
